title: Mixture of Layers: Dynamic Layer Routing for Visual Reasoning
abstract: Pre-trained vision encoders contain layer-wise visual representations that differ in spatial granularity, semantic abstraction, and sensitivity to local details. However, most Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on only the final or penultimate vision encoder representations or fixed aggregation rules, making visual abstraction largely query-agnostic and limiting access to fine-grained cues such as small objects, spatial details, text, and subtle visual attributes. In this work, we propose Mixture of Layers (MoL), an instruction-conditioned layer routing approach at the visual patch level that dynamically aggregates query-relevant latent representations from intermediate vision encoder layers. Given a text query, MoL predicts routing probabilities over vision encoder layers and performs a top-k sparse aggregation over selected hidden states at either the image level, patch level, or through a hybrid routing mechanism. In doing so, MoL enables query-adaptive access to layer-specific visual features for fine-grained visual reasoning. Our experiments across 7 fine-grained visual reasoning tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements, especially across fine-grained visual grounding and understanding tasks such as +18.9% improvement on V* in overall accuracy, +4.5% on HRBench4K, and +16.3% on CharXiv compared to the baseline MLLMs, without resorting to multi-resolution inputs, simple interleaving of multiple vision encoders, or increasing the number of patch tokens. We study vision encoders' receptive field scales across different layers and their sampling behaviors to provide an in-depth analysis of why layer-wise sampling is helpful, demonstrating that conditional visual representations are a key step towards better visual perception and reasoning in MLLMs. Our project page is available at https://wjdghks950.github.io/mol.github.io/.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.09440v2 的 25 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：promised。 本次实质更新：新实验对照改变对dual routing收益的证据解释，不是版本stamp更新。
analysis.ideaZh: MoL按query从vision encoder中间层稀疏取patch features，并以global/local disagreement控制reserve层。v2新增Dual Enc No Router对照：作者报告V*84.45→dual MoL90.34，但HR4K43.50持平、RealWorldQA53.86→52.55下降。新增对照让routing收益与任务代价更可审计；仍非严格routing-only实验，适合skim视觉接口设计，不能把token不变当作整体低成本。
analysis.motivationZh: 固定末层视觉features会丢失query所需细节，而dual encoder实验常混合routing与fusion贡献；v2新增一个no-router对照帮助约束后一解释。
analysis.methodZh: CLIP/SigLIP/DINOv2 aligned text tower提供query，router在image、patch或hybrid层级预测top-k分布。hybrid以weighted product-of-experts融合并用KL disagreement控制penultimate reserve。二阶段训练包括load balancing，dual encoder在各自routing后将DINOv2插值至CLIP grid并channel-concat/project，保持576视觉tokens。
methodFlow: 保存层级表示：vision encoder返回全部hidden states，aligned text encoder提取query。
稀疏层路由：image-level或每patch打分，再top-k选择并重归一化。
hybrid回退：global/local分布按query融合，以KL disagreement gate保留penultimate reserve表示。
输入语言模型：routed features经projector；dual模式将两个grid对齐并channel融合，按原token数送入LLM。
analysis.experimentsZh: Vicuna13B/CLIP与DINOv2、Llama3-8B/Phi1.5-SigLIP；LLaVA558K/665K或Bunny2M/695K二阶段配方，4×H100NVL。7类细粒度benchmark及传统VQA，dual branch输出576tokens。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告新增Dual Enc No Router V*84.45、GPT4V-hard70.59、OCR66.67；dual MoL对应90.34/82.35/66.67。相对新对照V*多5.89百分点，OCR持平。（v2 PDF p.6, Table3（v1无该baseline row））；作者报告dual no-router与dual MoL HR4K均43.50；RealWorldQA53.86→52.55，NaturalBench69.12→69.72。（v2 PDF p.6 Table3）；作者报告single CLIP+Vicuna patch MoL V*71.43→84.87；该原有结果并非v2新增。（v2 PDF p.6 Table1） 对照范围：TokenPacker、MLVF、DeepStack、Dense Connector、IGVA、TGIF；v2新增Dual Enc No Router对照。作者仍声明dual配置为whole-system比较，不应将新row视为完全隔离routing的matched causal消融。 消融与诊断：image-only、reserve、k=1/2/4、router variants及多backbone；Appendix Table9按method family/per-metric best汇总，不代表统一checkpoint全任务泛化。
analysis.insightZh: 原方法与v1相同；本次可发布增量是新增dual no-router实验对照，其V*/OCR/HRBench/RealWorldQA数值补充routing vs encoder/fusion的证据边界，而非再次包装原方法。
analysis.evidenceZh: query-conditioned top-k可按image/patch路由，hybrid保留reserve。（v2 PDF pp.3–5, §3, Fig.1, Eqs.(3)–(8)）；v2 Table3新加Dual Enc No Router baseline，v1对应Table3缺少该row。（archived v1 PDF p.6 Table3 vs v2 PDF p.6 Table3）；作者报告dual MoL的V*更高，HR4K持平而RealWorldQA下降。（v2 PDF p.6 Table3）；作者仍说明dual比较是whole-system，并未完全控制encoder/fusion因素。（v2 PDF p.8 §4.2）；多数large-model实验single-run，注意力/RF不是完整因果解释。（v2 PDF p.16 Appendix A; p.20 Appendix G）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 按query取回局部视觉细节可作为design/grounding agent的接口思路；新对照有助避免将dual encoder融合收益全部归因于routing。
analysis.caveatZh: 需要中间层hidden states和vision-aligned text encoder；仅末层接口或encoder-free架构不直接适用。；多数大型实验单次训练，无统计显著性；routing超参数随encoder/domain需要重调。；RF/attention仅diagnostics，不保证answer的causal faithfulness。；v2仍保留§4.4与Table5的image-only趋势矛盾，以及主表/附表部分CharXiv/reserve数值不一致。；新增no-router row改善对照覆盖但并未补充paired多seed或完全一致encoder/训练/checkpoint选择的证明。；全层features与额外text tower的实际显存/延迟未由token数或router参数比例充分刻画。；项目页Code标记Coming soon，不发布Code link。
